title: GitHub Issue Triage
summary: Label every newly opened GitHub issue with an LLM through a signed webhook.

secrets.name: GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: The secret you set on the GitHub webhook; used to verify X-Hub-Signature-256.

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: Fine-grained token with Issues: read and write on the target repositories.

setup: Publish the playbook and copy its webhook URL from Studio.
In the GitHub repo, add a webhook: payload URL from Studio, content type application/json, the same secret, and the Issues event only.
Open a test issue and check the labels.
